create_interactivedocument: create an InteractiveDocument instance with a language model and optional initial contents
open_question: ask the agent an open-ended question and append the question and response to the document
open_question_diversified: ask the agent a question, generate multiple samples, and randomly select one response
multiple_choice_question: present a multiple-choice question to the agent and return the index of the sampled answer
yes_no_question: present a yes or no question to the agent and return a boolean result
